items.title: Law firm that handled Lehman, Enron bankruptcies plans to wind down
items.brief: Leaders at Weil, Gotshal & Manges, the nearly century-old law firm that worked for companies from the Lehman Brothers to General Motors, recommended on Wednesday that the firm shut down.

items.title: Hayden Panettiere death investigation closed by police in South Carolina
items.brief: Police in South Carolina closed the investigation into actress Hayden Panettiere’s death after it was determined she died of an accidental drug overdose, the Greenville police department said Wednesday.

items.title: Trump administration kicks out Cuban diplomat from US as tensions rise

items.title: Flávio Bolsonaro says he will lead Brazil’s opposition in exile, after landing in US following election defeat
items.brief: Brazilian senator Flávio Bolsonaro has said he will lead his country’s opposition from the United States, where he arrived on Wednesday after fleeing Brazil following his defeat in Sunday’s presidential election.
